title: Compatible scheme identifications for the explicit affine pushout diagram
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram, c a colimiting cocone, i∈I, s:Y→Spec R(i), and t:Spec Γ(Y)≅Y. Form the explicit F and r of [def-pc-affine-base-change-ring-diagram] and C=colimit.cocone F. There exist σ(j):Spec F(j)≅Y×Spec R(j) (over Spec R(i)) for j in the nested upper tail, and τ:Spec C.pt≅Y×Spec c.pt. Their first projections are Spec(r followed by the initial-to-j map) followed by t, and Spec(r followed by C.ι(i)) followed by t. For j≤k, σ(k).hom followed by the geometric base-change arrow k→j equals Spec(F(j→k)) followed by σ(j).hom. For each j, τ.hom followed by the geometric limit-to-j arrow equals Spec(C.ι(j)) followed by σ(j). No complexes or derived categories are involved. The scheme morphisms and geometric base-change arrows use [def-pc-scheme].

source.place: Section 26.17, affine fibre products; Tag 09RE affine limit setup

proof.text: The order-tail functor to Under i is fully faithful and essentially surjective: recover a tail element from the right vertex of each under-object and its structure inequality. Since I is nonempty and filtered, the under restriction of hc is a colimit; whisker it by this equivalence.

Map that cocone through Under.pushout a and Under.forget Γ(Y). The first is a left adjoint and the second preserves nonempty connected colimits. Thus its vertex, the pushout of c.ι(i) and a, is canonically isomorphic to colimit F by coconePointUniqueUpToIso.

Apply Mathlib isPullback_SpecMap_pushout, flip its legs, and transport Spec Γ(Y) to Y along t using IsPullback.of_iso. Its isoPullback gives σ. Applying Spec to the preceding colimit-ring isomorphism gives τ. Compute both first projections with isoPullback_hom_fst, pushout.inr_desc and the colimit comparison injection equation.

For both transition identities, apply pullback.hom_ext. The first projection reduces to pushout.inr_desc, the second to pushout.inl_desc. At the colimit also use comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_inv to replace a colimit injection by the mapped cocone injection followed by the comparison inverse. All steps use universal properties and include zero rings, empty spectra and equality of indices.

proof_origin.place: Section 26.17, affine fibre products; Tag 09RE affine limit setup; expansion of lem-pc-affine-base-change-model-comparison-isos into the categorical transport and complex comparison steps

theorem exists_affineBaseChangeSchemeComparisons
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (t : Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) ≅ Y) :
    let F := affineBaseChangeRingDiagram R i Y s t
    let C := colimit.cocone F
    let r := affineBaseChangeInitialMap R i Y s t
    ∃ (σ : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
      Spec (F.obj j.val) ≅ pullback s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))
    (τ : Spec C.pt ≅ pullback s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))),
      (∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
        (σ j).hom ≫ pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))) =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r ≫ F.map (homOfLE j.property)) ≫ t.hom) ∧
      (τ.hom ≫ pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r ≫ C.ι.app ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) ≫ t.hom) ∧
      (∀ (j k : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (hjk : j ≤ k),
        (σ k).hom ≫ baseChangeMap s
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))
          (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE k.val.property))))
          (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
            (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)) =
          Spec.map (F.map (homOfLE hjk)) ≫ (σ j).hom) ∧
      (∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
        τ.hom ≫ baseChangeMap s
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))
          (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
          (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j.val))
            (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE j.val.property)])) =
          Spec.map (C.ι.app j.val) ≫ (σ j).hom)
